name: SFS Real Estate Investment Trust
source: CRON 20261014: SFS Real Estate Investment Trust statement of comprehensive income for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), Jun-26 column, thousands of naira scaled to naira. Total income less admin and other expenses equals the printed net income exactly. The trust charged no tax and reports no finance cost, so operating profit, profit before tax and net income are the same printed figure. Basic earnings per unit stored in naira. | SFS Real Estate Investment Trust 2025 Annual Report & Accounts, audited (DoC Advisory, signed March 2026). Figures read from the fund's own statements for the year ended 31 December 2025. N'000 converted to absolute NGN. source_url https://sfsreit.com/pdf/relations/sfs-reit-annual-report-2025.pdf
source_note: Gap fill 2026-11-12: Q3 2026 column added from the trust own unaudited nine month statement filed with the NGX on 16 October 2026. Total income 467,305 less administrative and other expenses 120,117 equals the printed net income of 347,188, and the tax charge is nil as printed. | earlier note: Statement of Profit or Loss and Other Comprehensive Income: Total income N717,386k, Total operating expenses N88,899k, Net Income N628,487k, Net income per unit N31.42. A fair value gain of N3,483,050k on investment properties, from the IAS 40 fair value model adopted in 2025, takes total comprehensive profit to N4,111,537k; the panel's income schema has no row for that gain, so the fair value movement is recorded here and not allocated to a row. 2024 comparatives are the audited figures printed in the same statement. The fund prints no income tax line and no finance cost line, so operating result and net income are the same figure.

rows.label: Revenue
rows.source: SFS Real Estate Investment Trust unaudited statement of comprehensive income for the nine months ended 30 September 2026, NGN thousands: rental income 185,245, fixed interest income 182,060, profit on disposal of investment property 100,000, total income 467,305, administrative and other expenses 120,117, financial charges nil, net income for the period 347,188, earnings per unit 17.36 naira. Revenue is stored as the printed total income, which includes the 100,000 one off profit on disposal of investment property.
